Problem Statement:
Given a set of numbers of length N. Your task is to find the quad ret (x1,x2,x3,x4) which will result the sum in 1. If quad ret exists print Yes else print No 
Input Description:
First line contains a number N. Next line contains n space separated numbers 
Output Description:
Print Yes or No 
Explanation:
1,-1,-2,3 is quad ret. Because its sum is 3-2-1+1=1 
Sample Input:
5
1 -1 2 -2 3 
Sample Output:
Yes
